evals.name: should-trigger-fresh-onboarding
evals.prompt: I need to set up this boilerplate for the Curacity project. Backend is Node.js + Express, frontend is React. Start by discovering the architecture.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-discovery. Confirms scope (Fresh onboarding). Begins Phase 1: Constitution -- asks for repo paths/access, detects stack, writes `.context/project-config.md`, records the project assessment, then writes the business model and glossary as sections of the `business-domain-context` map (read back with `bun run context:map business-domain-context`). Phases 2-3 write the `infra-context` map; Phase 4 is a backlog connection check that writes no file. Does not produce PRD/SRS markdown, `risk-assessment.md` or `ACCESS.md`. Waits for confirmation between phases before advancing.

evals.name: should-redirect-business-data-map-regeneration
evals.prompt: Generate the business-data-map.md for this project. Look at the source code and the database.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT generate the map inside this skill and does NOT claim to own it. Redirects to `project-context` mode `data` (`/project-context data`), which is where the entity/flow/state-machine extraction lives and which writes the map inside `business-data-context`. May state which discovery artifacts that mode depends on, and offer to run Phase 1 + Phase 3 first if there is no `.context/project-config.md` or the `infra-context` map is still a placeholder. Does not reference a context-generators file: this skill has no such reference.

evals.name: should-redirect-api-architecture-request
evals.prompt: The api-architecture.md is stale. Regenerate it with the current endpoints.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT regenerate api-architecture.md inside this skill. Either declines (if invoked) or activates only to redirect: explains the split — `bun run api:sync` for technical endpoint sync (TypeScript types from OpenAPI) and `project-context` mode `api` (`/project-context api`) for the business angle (auth flows, critical paths). Does not point at a context-generators file: that reference no longer exists, and the deferral note now lives in this skill's SKILL.md routing table.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-write-e2e-test
evals.prompt: Write an E2E test for the login flow.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate project-discovery. Should route to test-automation (KATA test authoring). project-discovery is for onboarding and context generation, not writing test code.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-kata-concept-question
evals.prompt: What is KATA and how does it work?
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate project-discovery. General conceptual question answerable without a skill. project-discovery is for reverse engineering a target project; KATA adaptation belongs to `/test-framework-adaptation`, and neither exists to explain the framework in the abstract.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-run-regression
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate project-discovery. Should route to regression-testing. project-discovery never executes test suites.

evals.name: should-update-infra-map-sections-only
evals.prompt: We moved from Vercel to Fly.io last month. Re-run discovery for the infrastructure part.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-discovery for Phase 3 only. Runs `bun run context:map infra-context --list`, sees a generated map, runs the staleness check per section, regenerates ONLY the stale sections (e.g. `environments`, `ci-cd`), shows a section-level diff and waits for approval before writing. Never regenerates the whole map, never writes `.context/infrastructure/*.md`, and leaves any legacy markdown there untouched (input only).
